description: This file implements a retry system for gRPC calls within the PySpark framework, including classes for retry policies, state management, and retry logic, as well as functions to extract retry information from gRPC exceptions.

classes.name: RetryPolicy
classes.description: Defines the configuration for retry behavior, including parameters like max retries, backoff, jitter, and server retry delay recognition.

classes.name: RetryPolicyState
classes.description: Maintains the runtime state of a RetryPolicy, tracking attempts and calculating wait times between retries.

classes.name: AttemptManager
classes.description: Context manager to handle exceptions during retry attempts, determining whether to retry or propagate exceptions.

classes.name: Retrying
classes.description: Main class orchestrating the retry process, applying policies in order, and managing retry attempts.

classes.name: RetryException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating an error that should always be retried.

classes.name: DefaultPolicy
classes.description: A predefined retry policy with sensible defaults, including maximum retries and backoff parameters.

methods.name: can_retry
methods.description: Determines if an exception is eligible for a retry based on the policy.

methods.name: to_state
methods.description: Converts a RetryPolicy into its runtime state object.

methods.name: next_attempt
methods.description: Calculates the wait time before the next retry attempt, considering backoff, jitter, and server retry delay.

methods.name: extract_retry_info
methods.description: Extracts RetryInfo from a gRPC RpcError, if available.

methods.name: extract_retry_delay
methods.description: Retrieves the retry delay in milliseconds from a gRPC RpcError, if present.
